resources.string: The cover of whatever you are listening to.

Now Playing needs notification access to see what your music apps are playing. Android only grants this in system settings, so the button below opens the right page.\n\nIt reads the album from the media session and nothing else.
Without notification access, Now Playing cannot see what is playing and the wallpaper will not change.
This device has no notification access screen, so Now Playing cannot be granted access here. Grant it from system settings if your device offers it elsewhere.
Artwork is looked up on any connection. One lookup per album, not per track.
Artwork is looked up only on an unmetered connection. The wallpaper keeps the last cover elsewhere.
